stem: Which statement best reflects current evidence on atypical or mixed sex expression in Cannabis sativa?
choices: Expression can reflect interacting genetic, developmental, hormonal, treatment, and environmental factors, so one observation rarely proves a single universal cause
One specific environmental stress always causes the same response in every genotype
A feminized seed label makes direct reproductive scouting unnecessary
Sex expression can be determined reliably from leaf shape alone
rationale: Current review literature supports a context-dependent, multicausal model. Seed category and environmental history inform expectations but do not replace direct reproductive observation or justify one-cause certainty.
